ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience tape captures a high‑energy Dead show with an exciting Miles Davis opener and solid performances throughout.
ai_review.review: The reviewer notes that this is the better of two versions and praises the state‑of‑the‑art 1970 audience patch, describing it as a good job of taping. The concert itself is portrayed as frantic and edgy, with strong playing from both Miles Davis' set and the Dead, though the original setlist was scrambled. A single criticism is aimed at the “murky weirdness” of Cowboy Song, but overall the performance is praised.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review gives a 4‑star rating and highlights both strong musical performance and good recording quality; limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience patch described as a state‑of‑the‑art 1970 taping with clear capture of the band; no major dropouts or muffling mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Corrected setlist shows a fast‑moving, eclectic first set that builds into an intense mid‑set stretch; overall flow is energetic despite the original scrambled listing.
